# 1822. Sign of the Product of an Array

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def arraySign(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 1
        for num in nums:
            if num == 0:
                ans = 0
                break
            if num < 0:
                ans *= -1
        return ans
```
